// Loads the wasm32 build of `core/model_operations/operation_applier` — the // sole browser-mode operation engine per DEC-020 / ADR-0001. The generated // glue and wasm artifact are produced by `npm run build:wasm` into // `public/wasm-engine/` (TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001: Vite serves `public/` at the // site root in dev and copies it verbatim into `dist`, so the one root // `/wasm-engine/` URL resolves identically under the dev server, `vite // preview` of the production dist, and the packaged tauri:// asset protocol) // and are not committed; an absent artifact is an explicit named failure // (WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT) with the build command in the message — never a // silent fallback to another engine, because no other engine exists.

export const WASM_ENGINE_ABSENT_DIAGNOSTIC = "WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT"; export const WASM_ENGINE_BUILD_COMMAND = "npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop";

export type WasmOperationEngine = { validateOperationJson: (modelJson: string, intentJson: string, claimedModelHashJson: string) => string; applyOperationJson: (modelJson: string, intentJson: string, claimedModelHashJson: string) => string; // H1 / F-5a hash seam: the engine's canonicalization and hashing, exported // so the frontend never re-implements either. Both throw on invalid JSON // input (WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID). canonicalJsonString: (valueJson: string) => string; canonicalSha256Hex: (valueJson: string) => string; };

type GeneratedGlueModule = { default: (options?: { module_or_path: BufferSource | string | URL }) => Promise<unknown>; validate_operation_json: (modelJson: string, intentJson: string, claimedModelHashJson: string) => string; apply_operation_json: (modelJson: string, intentJson: string, claimedModelHashJson: string) => string; canonical_json_string: (valueJson: string) => string; canonical_sha256_hex: (valueJson: string) => string; };

// The browser specifier is intentionally held in a constant (not an inline // literal) so neither tsc nor Vite resolves it at build time: the generated // module is absent until `npm run build:wasm` runs, and its absence must be // a runtime diagnostic, not a compile failure. `public/` contents are served // at the site root in every browser lane. const GENERATED_GLUE_FILENAME = "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.js"; const GENERATED_WASM_FILENAME = "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm"; const BROWSER_GLUE_PATH = `/wasm-engine/${GENERATED_GLUE_FILENAME}`;

// The browser import must be a FULLY-QUALIFIED URL (origin included), not the // root-absolute path: Vite's dev transform wraps dynamic imports in its // `injectQuery(url, "import")` client helper, and the dev server refuses to // serve publicDir files with the `?import` query (HTTP 500). The helper skips // URLs that carry a protocol, so resolving against `location.href` makes the // browser import the raw asset identically under the dev server, `vite // preview`, and the packaged `tauri://localhost/` asset protocol. function browserGlueUrl(): string { return new URL(BROWSER_GLUE_PATH, globalThis.location.href).href; }

let enginePromise: Promise<WasmOperationEngine> | null = null;

function absenceError(stage: string, detail: string): Error { return new Error( `${WASM_ENGINE_ABSENT_DIAGNOSTIC}: ${stage}: ${detail} — the wasm operation engine is required in ` + `browser mode (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) and no fallback engine exists. Build it with \`${WASM_ENGINE_BUILD_COMMAND}\`.` ); }

// Node / Vitest: locate the generated assets on disk. Vite's test transform // rewrites `import.meta.url` to a root-relative file URL (`file:///src/...`), // so module-relative resolution alone is unreliable; probe the deterministic // candidates and fail loudly listing every probed path. This probes locations // of ONE artifact set — it is not an engine fallback. async function locateAssetsUnderNode(): Promise<{ glueUrl: string; wasmBytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> }> { const fsSpecifier = "node:fs/promises"; const pathSpecifier = "node:path"; const urlSpecifier = "node:url"; const { readFile } = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ fsSpecifier)) as typeof import("node:fs/promises"); const path = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ pathSpecifier)) as typeof import("node:path"); const { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ urlSpecifier)) as typeof import("node:url");

const candidates: string[] = []; try { // Real ESM: `public/wasm-engine/` relative to this module's directory // (`src/services/wasmEngine/`). candidates.push( path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..", "..", "public", "wasm-engine") ); } catch { // import.meta.url is not a parseable file URL under this transform. } // Vitest with cwd at the desktop workspace, and runs from the repo root. candidates.push(path.resolve(process.cwd(), "public", "wasm-engine")); candidates.push(path.resolve(process.cwd(), "apps", "desktop", "public", "wasm-engine"));

for (const candidate of candidates) { try { // Copy into a fresh Uint8Array: Node's Buffer is typed over // ArrayBufferLike, which BufferSource rejects. const wasmBytes = new Uint8Array(await readFile(path.join(candidate, GENERATED_WASM_FILENAME))); return { glueUrl: pathToFileURL(path.join(candidate, GENERATED_GLUE_FILENAME)).href, wasmBytes }; } catch { // Probe the next candidate; absence is reported below with all paths. } } throw absenceError("wasm artifact not found on disk", `probed: ${candidates.join(", ")}`); }

async function instantiate(): Promise<WasmOperationEngine> { const runningUnderNode = typeof process !== "undefined" && Boolean(process.versions?.node); let glue: GeneratedGlueModule;

if (runningUnderNode) { const { glueUrl, wasmBytes } = await locateAssetsUnderNode(); try { glue = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ glueUrl)) as GeneratedGlueModule; } catch (error) { throw absenceError("generated glue module import failed", String(error)); } try { await glue.default({ module_or_path: wasmBytes }); } catch (error) { throw absenceError("wasm instantiation failed", String(error)); } } else { try { glue = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ browserGlueUrl())) as GeneratedGlueModule; } catch (error) { throw absenceError("generated glue module import failed", String(error)); } try { // Real browser: the wasm-bindgen web-target default path fetches the // sibling _bg.wasm relative to the glue module URL (`import.meta.url`), // which is `/wasm-engine/` in every browser lane. await glue.default(); } catch (error) { throw absenceError("wasm instantiation failed", String(error)); } }

return { validateOperationJson: glue.validate_operation_json, applyOperationJson: glue.apply_operation_json, canonicalJsonString: glue.canonical_json_string, canonicalSha256Hex: glue.canonical_sha256_hex }; }

/// Lazy singleton: first caller triggers instantiation; failures are not /// cached so a later call after `npm run build:wasm` succeeds. export function loadWasmEngine(): Promise<WasmOperationEngine> { if (!enginePromise) { enginePromise = instantiate().catch((error: unknown) => { enginePromise = null; throw error; }); } return enginePromise; }

SEC-CA001-0222 Component: apps/desktop/src/styles.css

/* * OpenPipeStress desktop shell stylesheet. * * Structure (TP-APP-R2-UXSHELL-001): * 1. Base + chrome ......... :root, body, .loading-screen, .topbar, * .project-toolbar, .boundary-strip, .app-footer * 2. Workspace layout ...... .workspace (column flex filling the shell), * .modeling-workspace (persistent spatial core: model tree | 3D * viewport | property inspector, each in an independently scrolling * .workspace-pane), .workspace-dock (guided workbench rail/current-step * surface, always-visible .workspace-nav section tabs + scrolling * .workspace-dock-body holding one .workspace-dock-section per nav item; * inactive sections are display:none but stay mounted so panel state * survives navigation) * 3. Panel primitives ...... .panel, .panel-title, .panel-subtitle * 4. Feature panels ........ model tree, inspector/editor intents, * viewport, load-case manager, solve/results/report, exports, audit * panels (one block per feature, in source order below) * * Layout invariants: every scroll container is a .workspace-pane, the * .workspace-dock-body, or an explicitly bounded panel region (e.g. the * operation apply queue); panels grow with content instead of clipping it, * and form rows wrap (flex-wrap / auto-fit grids) rather than overflow. */

:root { color: #1d2424; background: #ecefeb; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-synthesis: none; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; }

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

body { margin: 0; min-width: 1120px; min-height: 760px; }

button, input, textarea { font: inherit; }

button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f08c22; outline-offset: 2px; }

.loading-screen { display: grid; min-height: 100vh; place-items: center; color: #2d3837; }

.app-shell { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto auto 1fr auto; height: 100vh; min-height: 760px; }

.topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 14px 18px; color: #f8faf7; background: #263331; border-bottom: 1px solid #182321; }

.topbar h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; }

.topbar p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #c7d0cb; font-size: 13px; }

.topbar-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; }

.badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 9px; min-height: 30px; border: 1px solid #53635f; border-radius: 4px; color: #f8faf7; background: #33423f; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }

.project-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c8d0cb; background: #f7f9f6; color: #2d3837; font-size: 12px; }

.project-toolbar strong, .project-toolbar span { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.project-toolbar-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; flex: 0 0 auto; gap: 8px; }

.project-toolbar button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.project-toolbar button:disabled { color: #7b8580; cursor: not-allowed; }

.boundary-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; min-height: 38px; padding: 7px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c8d0cb; background: #edf2ef; }

.boundary-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; color: #2d3837; font-size: 11px; }

.boundary-item strong { white-space: nowrap; }

.boundary-item code { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #4d5a56; font-family: inherit; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

/* === 2. Workspace layout (TP-APP-R2-UXSHELL-001) === */

.workspace { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-height: 0; padding: 10px; }

/* Persistent spatial core (PRD 14.1): model tree | viewport | inspector. */ .modeling-workspace { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 280px minmax(420px, 1fr) 380px; gap: 10px; flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 240px; }

/* Each core column scrolls independently; panels inside grow with content. */ .workspace-pane { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; }

.workspace-pane > .panel, .workspace-pane > .viewport-shell { flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* Section dock: always-visible navigation + one scrolling section at a time. */ .workspace-dock { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; flex: 1.15 1 0; min-height: 260px; }

.guided-workbench { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(360px, 1fr) minmax(280px, 0.8fr) minmax(360px, 1.05fr); align-items: start; gap: 10px; min-height: 96px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #c3ccc6; border-radius: 6px; background: #f8faf7; }

.journey-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; min-width: 0; }

.journey-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 2px 7px; min-width: 0; min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #c7d0cb; border-radius: 5px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }

.journey-step.active { border-color: #2d5b50; background: #e4f0eb; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #2d5b50; }

.journey-step > svg { grid-row: 1 / 3; color: #4d5a56; }

.journey-step span, .journey-step small { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.journey-step span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

.journey-step small { color: #66736f; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; }

.current-step-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; min-width: 0; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #d7ded9; border-radius: 5px; background: #ffffff; }

.current-step-kicker { display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; color: #68736f; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; }

.current-step-panel h2 { margin: 0; color: #1f2c29; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.2; }

.current-step-panel p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #475451; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; }

.current-step-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.75fr) minmax(0, 1.25fr); gap: 7px; }

.current-step-facts span { min-width: 0; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid #e1e6e3; border-radius: 4px; background: #f8faf8; color: #52605b; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.guided-journey-stack { display: grid; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; }

.guided-journey-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px; }

.guided-journey-tab { min-width: 0; min-height: 24px; padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid #c7d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #31403d; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.guided-journey-tab.active { border-color: #2d5b50; background: #e4f0eb; }

.a12-authoring-journey, .r3-guided-flow { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto auto; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #d7ded9; border-radius: 5px; background: #ffffff; }

.r3-guided-flow { grid-template-rows: auto auto auto auto; }

.a12-journey-header, .r3-flow-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: start; gap: 8px; }

.a12-journey-header span, .r3-flow-header span { display: block; color: #68736f; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; }

.a12-journey-header h2, .r3-flow-header h2 { margin: 1px 0 0; color: #1f2c29; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.2; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.a12-journey-header strong, .r3-flow-header strong { padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid #dbe2dd; border-radius: 10px; color: #263331; background: #f4f7f5; font-size: 11px; }

.a12-journey-grid, .r3-flow-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; }

.a12-journey-step, .r3-flow-step { display: grid; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; min-height: 21px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #d6ded9; border-radius: 4px; color: #31403d; background: #f8faf8; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }

.a12-journey-step.next, .r3-flow-step.next { border-color: #8d7033; background: #fff7df; }

.a12-journey-step.complete, .r3-flow-step.complete { border-color: #9fb8aa; background: #edf5ef; }

.a12-journey-step.selected, .r3-flow-step.selected { border-color: #2d5b50; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #2d5b50; }

.a12-journey-step span, .a12-journey-step small, .r3-flow-step span, .r3-flow-step small { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.a12-journey-step span, .r3-flow-step span { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; }

.a12-journey-step small, .r3-flow-step small { color: #64716d; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; }

.r3-flow-blocker { min-width: 0; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid #e4d3a6; border-radius: 4px; color: #554519; background: #fff8e4; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.a12-journey-actions, .r3-flow-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }

.a12-journey-actions span, .r3-flow-actions span { min-width: 0; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid #e1e6e3; border-radius: 4px; background: #f8faf8; color: #52605b; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.a12-journey-actions button, .r3-flow-actions button { min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 7px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }

.a12-journey-actions button:disabled { color: #71807a; background: #eef2ef; cursor: progress; }

.workspace-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }

.workspace-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 5px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }

.workspace-nav-item.active { color: #f8faf7; background: #31403d; border-color: #31403d; }

.workspace-journey-item code { color: #586460; font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; }

.workspace-dock-body { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; }

.workspace-dock-section { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(380px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; align-items: start; }

.workspace-dock-section > .panel { min-width: 0; }

.workspace-dock-section > .review-apply-drawer { min-width: 0; }

/* Inactive sections stay mounted (state survives navigation) but are fully hidden, including from the accessibility tree. */ .workspace-dock-section.inactive { display: none; }

/* === 3. Panel primitives === */

.panel, .viewport-shell { min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 6px; background: #fbfcfa; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(27 39 37 / 8%); }

.panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 12px; }

.panel-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 10px; color: #465450; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }

.model-tree { overflow: auto; }

/* Two-row layout: filter input + clear button on top, match summary below. The single-row layout overlapped at the narrow tree-column width. */ .model-tree-controls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 32px; align-items: center; gap: 6px 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }

.model-tree-controls > span { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

.model-tree-controls label { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }

.model-tree-controls label span, .model-tree-controls > span { color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }

.model-tree-controls input { min-width: 0; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; }

.model-tree-controls button { grid-row: 1; grid-column: 2; display: inline-grid; width: 32px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.model-tree-controls button:disabled { color: #9aa39f; cursor: not-allowed; }

.tree-group h3 { margin: 14px 0 6px; color: #6b736f; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

.tree-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; gap: 7px; width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }

.tree-row.active { background: #dce8e2; }

.tree-row strong, .tree-row small { display: block; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.tree-row strong { font-size: 13px; }

.tree-row small { margin-top: 2px; color: #68746f; font-size: 11px; }

.inspector h2, .agent-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 15px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.inspector dl { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; overflow: auto; }

.inspector dl div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 100px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; }

.inspector dt { color: #69736f; font-size: 12px; }

.inspector dd { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.inspector { overflow: auto; }

.editor-intent { display: grid; gap: 9px; margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #d8dfdb; }

.editor-intent h3 { margin: 0; color: #465450; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

.editor-intent-controls { display: grid; gap: 8px; }

.editor-intent-controls label { display: grid; gap: 4px; }

.editor-intent-controls label span { color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; }

.editor-intent-controls input, .editor-intent-controls select { min-width: 0; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; }

.editor-intent-checkbox-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }

.editor-intent-checkbox-grid label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid #d3d9d5; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #34413e; font-size: 12px; }

.editor-intent-checkbox-grid input { min-width: auto; min-height: auto; padding: 0; }

.editor-intent-controls button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.editor-intent-controls button:disabled { color: #9aa39f; cursor: not-allowed; }

.editor-intent-preview, .editor-intent-queue article { padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d9dfdb; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; }

.editor-intent-meta, .editor-intent-queue { display: grid; gap: 7px; }

.editor-intent-fact { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; padding: 5px 6px; border: 1px solid #e1e6e3; border-radius: 4px; background: #f8faf8; }

.editor-intent-fact span, .editor-intent-queue small, .editor-intent-queue span { color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; }

.editor-intent-fact strong, .editor-intent-queue strong { color: #25312f; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.editor-intent-queue article { display: grid; gap: 3px; }

.editor-inline-validation { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-height: 28px; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid #d9dfdb; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #2d3837; font-size: 12px; }

.editor-inline-validation strong, .editor-inline-validation small { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.editor-inline-validation small { color: #5f6c68; font-size: 11px; }

.viewport-shell { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto auto; }

.viewport-frame { position: relative; z-index: 1; height: clamp(240px, 25vw, 325px); min-height: 240px; overflow: hidden; }

.viewport-toolbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 12px; min-height: 36px; padding: 9px 12px; color: #31403d; background: #edf2ef; border-bottom: 1px solid #c8d0cb; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

.viewport-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; cursor: crosshair; }

.viewport-canvas canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }

.viewport-fallback { display: grid; height: 100%; min-height: 320px; place-items: center; padding: 24px; color: #44504c; background: #f4f6f4; font-size: 13px; text-align: center; }

.viewport-selection-layer { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }

.viewport-toolbar > span { min-width: 0; }

.viewport-deformation-status { display: grid; flex: 1 1 auto; gap: 2px; max-width: 58%; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 3px solid #8a9691; color: #31403d; }

.viewport-deformation-status strong, .viewport-deformation-status small { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.viewport-deformation-status small { color: #66736f; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }

.viewport-deformation-status.available { border-left: 3px solid #0f8f85; }

.viewport-deformation-status.blocked { border-left: 3px solid #b54708; }

.viewport-select-target { position: absolute; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; width: 58px; height: 26px; padding: 0 5px; border: 1px solid rgba(46, 68, 62, 0.48); border-radius: 4px; color: #22312e; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(35, 45, 42, 0.14); cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }

.viewport-select-target span { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.viewport-select-target.node { border-color: rgba(47, 111, 115, 0.6); }

.viewport-select-target.pipe { border-color: rgba(79, 111, 115, 0.62); }

.viewport-select-target.support { border-color: rgba(107, 125, 73, 0.62); }

.viewport-select-target.component { border-color: rgba(135, 76, 98, 0.62); }

.viewport-select-target.active, .viewport-select-target:focus-visible { color: #141f1d; background: #fff4df; border-color: #d57d16; outline: 2px solid rgba(213, 125, 22, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

.viewport-intents { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border-top: 1px solid #c8d0cb; background: #fbfcfa; }

.viewport-intent-controls, .viewport-intent-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-content: start; gap: 7px; }

.viewport-node-form, .viewport-pipe-form { display: grid; gap: 7px; width: 100%; }

.viewport-node-form { grid-template-columns: minmax(96px, 1.2fr) minmax(96px, 1.2fr) repeat(3, minmax(52px, 0.7fr)) auto; }

.viewport-pipe-form { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(86px, 1fr)); }

.viewport-node-form label, .viewport-pipe-form label, .viewport-endpoint-field { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }

.viewport-node-form span, .viewport-pipe-form span { color: #54615d; font-size: 11px; }

.viewport-node-form input, .viewport-pipe-form input, .viewport-pipe-form select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 30px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; }

.viewport-field-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; min-height: 18px; }

.viewport-pipe-form .viewport-endpoint-pick { align-self: center; min-height: 20px; padding: 1px 6px; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; }

.viewport-pipe-form .viewport-endpoint-pick[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #141f1d; background: #fff4df; border-color: #d57d16; }

.viewport-intent-actions button, .viewport-node-form button, .viewport-pipe-form button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.viewport-node-form button, .viewport-pipe-form button { align-self: end; white-space: nowrap; }

.viewport-node-form button:disabled, .viewport-pipe-form button:disabled { color: #7d8985; background: #eef2ef; cursor: not-allowed; }

.viewport-intent-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; min-height: 30px; }

.viewport-intent-list p { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; color: #55625e; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.viewport-intent-list article { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid #d9dfdb; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #2d3837; }

.viewport-intent-list strong, .viewport-intent-list span, .viewport-intent-list small { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.viewport-intent-list strong { font-size: 12px; }

.viewport-intent-list span, .viewport-intent-list small { color: #5f6c68; font-size: 11px; }

@media (max-width: 1040px) { .viewport-intents, .viewport-node-form, .viewport-pipe-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

@media (max-height: 840px) { .workspace { gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; }

.modeling-workspace { flex: 0 1 210px; min-height: 210px; }

.workspace-dock { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 300px; } }

.report-panel { min-height: 360px; }

.load-case-row, .primitive-load-row, .combination-summary-row { display: grid; gap: 3px; width: 100%; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d9dfdb; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }

.load-case-row.active, .primitive-load-row.active, .combination-summary-row.active { border-color: #86aaa0; background: #eef7f2; outline: 2px solid rgba(76, 127, 109, 0.18); outline-offset: -2px; }

.combination-term-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }

.combination-term-row { min-height: 28px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid #d9dfdb; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; font-size: 11px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.load-magnitude-editor, .load-metadata-editor, .combination-basis-editor, .combination-factor-editor, .combination-term-create-editor, .load-case-create-editor, .primitive-load-create-editor { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 2px 0 10px; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid #d8dfdb; border-radius: 4px; background: #f8faf8; }

.load-editor-heading { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1.3fr); align-items: center; gap: 6px; }

.load-editor-heading strong { font-size: 12px; }

.load-editor-controls, .load-metadata-controls, .combination-basis-controls, .combination-factor-controls, .combination-delete-controls, .load-case-delete-controls, .combination-create-controls, .combination-term-create-controls, .load-case-create-controls, .primitive-load-create-controls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(72px, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: 7px; }

.load-metadata-controls { grid-template-columns: minmax(72px, 0.7fr) minmax(92px, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }

.load-case-create-controls { grid-template-columns: minmax(92px, 0.8fr) minmax(120px, 1fr) minmax(110px, 0.8fr) minmax(86px, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr) auto; }

.combination-term-create-controls { grid-template-columns: minmax(126px, 1fr) minmax(98px, 0.8fr) minmax(80px, 0.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }

.combination-create-controls { grid-template-columns: minmax(118px, 0.9fr) minmax(130px, 1fr) minmax(92px, 0.7fr) minmax(104px, 0.8fr) minmax(74px, 0.5fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }

.combination-delete-controls, .load-case-delete-controls { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }

.load-editor-controls label, .load-metadata-controls label, .combination-basis-controls label, .combination-factor-controls label, .combination-delete-controls label, .load-case-delete-controls label, .combination-create-controls label, .combination-term-create-controls label, .load-case-create-controls label, .primitive-load-create-controls label { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }

.load-editor-controls input, .load-metadata-controls input, .load-metadata-controls select, .combination-basis-controls input, .combination-factor-controls input, .combination-delete-controls input, .load-case-delete-controls input, .combination-create-controls input, .combination-create-controls select, .combination-term-create-controls input, .combination-term-create-controls select, .load-case-create-controls input, .primitive-load-create-controls input, .primitive-load-create-controls select { min-width: 0; height: 30px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; }

.load-editor-controls button, .load-metadata-controls button, .combination-basis-controls button, .combination-factor-controls button, .combination-delete-controls button, .load-case-delete-controls button, .combination-create-controls button, .combination-term-create-controls button, .load-case-create-controls button, .primitive-load-create-controls button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }

.load-editor-controls button:disabled, .load-metadata-controls button:disabled, .combination-basis-controls button:disabled, .combination-factor-controls button:disabled, .combination-delete-controls button:disabled, .load-case-delete-controls button:disabled, .combination-create-controls button:disabled, .combination-term-create-controls button:disabled, .load-case-create-controls button:disabled, .primitive-load-create-controls button:disabled { color: #7d8985; background: #eef2ef; cursor: not-allowed; }

.comparison-summary { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; }

.comparison-fact span { color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; }

.comparison-delta-header, .comparison-delta-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(145px, 1.5fr) minmax(72px, 0.75fr) minmax(96px, 0.9fr) minmax(70px, 0.6fr); gap: 6px; width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid #e1e6e3; text-align: left; }

.status-pill strong { color: #25312f; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.diagnostic-controls label span, .diagnostic-controls > span { color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }

.diagnostic-controls input { min-width: 0; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; }

.diagnostic-controls button { display: inline-grid; width: 32px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.diagnostic-controls button:disabled { color: #9aa39f; cursor: not-allowed; }

.diagnostic-severity-summary { display: grid; grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }

.diagnostic-severity-summary span { min-width: 0; padding: 5px 6px; border: 1px solid #d8dfdb; border-radius: 4px; color: #65716c; background: #f7f9f6; font-size: 11px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.diagnostic-severity-summary strong { color: #25312f; }

.result-groups { display: grid; gap: 10px; overflow: auto; }

.result-controls { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }

.result-family-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(92px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }

.result-family-row button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.result-family-row button span { overflow: hidden; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.result-family-row button strong { font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.result-family-row button.result-family-active { border-color: #2d5b50; color: #ffffff; background: #2d5b50; }

.result-filter-row, .result-page-row { display: grid; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

.result-filter-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto 32px; }

.result-page-row { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }

.result-filter-row label { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }

.result-page-size { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }

.result-filter-row label span, .result-filter-row > span, .result-page-size span, .result-page-row > span { color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }

.result-controls input, .result-controls select { min-width: 0; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; }

.result-filter-row button { display: inline-grid; width: 32px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.result-page-actions { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; }

.result-page-actions button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 4px; color: #25312f; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.result-controls button:disabled { color: #9aa39f; cursor: not-allowed; }

.result-group { display: grid; gap: 5px; }

.result-group h3 { margin: 0; color: #465450; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

.result-group tbody tr { cursor: pointer; }

.selected-result-row { background: #e8f1ed; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #2d5b50; }

.result-detail-panel, .diagnostic-detail-panel, .mechanics-gap-ledger { display: grid; gap: 8px; }

.result-detail-panel h3, .diagnostic-detail-panel h3, .mechanics-gap-ledger h3 { margin: 0; color: #465450; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

.result-detail-panel dl, .diagnostic-detail-panel dl { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin: 0; }

.result-detail-panel dl div, .diagnostic-detail-panel dl div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 116px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; }

.result-detail-panel dt, .diagnostic-detail-panel dt, .gap-list small { color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; }

.result-detail-panel dd, .diagnostic-detail-panel dd { margin: 0; color: #25312f; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.endpoint-pair { display: grid; gap: 6px; }

.endpoint-pair h4 { margin: 0; color: #465450; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

.gap-list { display: grid; gap: 7px; }

.gap-list strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; }

.gap-list small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; }

.gap-list p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: #3a4643; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; }

.primary-action, .secondary-action, .review-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 36px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #22302d; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }

.primary-action { color: #ffffff; background: #2d5b50; }

.secondary-action { margin-bottom: 10px; color: #24322f; background: #e6eee9; }

.review-action { color: #63706b; background: #eef1ef; border-color: #cbd3ce; cursor: not-allowed; }

table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }

th, td { padding: 8px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe4e1; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

th { color: #59645f; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; }

.muted { margin: 0; color: #68736f; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; }

.diff-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; }

.diff-list small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: #66716d; }

.report-line { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d9dfdb; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; }

.report-line span { color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; }

.report-line strong { color: #25312f; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.report-note { display: block; margin-top: 10px; color: #65716c; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.35; }

.app-footer { min-height: 34px; padding: 9px 18px; color: #3f4a46; background: #e0e5e1; border-top: 1px solid #c7d0cb; font-size: 12px; }

@media (max-width: 1320px) { body { min-width: 960px; }

.modeling-workspace { grid-template-columns: 250px minmax(400px, 1fr) 340px; min-height: 230px; }

.workspace { gap: 8px; padding: 8px; }

.workspace-dock { min-height: 280px; }

.workspace-dock-section { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr)); }

.workspace-nav-item { min-height: 30px; padding: 4px 9px; font-size: 12px; }

.journey-rail { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

.operation-apply-panel .muted { margin-bottom: 8px; }

/* The apply queue can grow long during authoring; bound it and let the queue scroll inside the panel instead of pushing the section off screen. */ .operation-apply-panel { min-height: 230px; max-height: 560px; overflow: auto; }

.operation-apply-panel .operation-record-list { overflow: visible; }

.operation-history-actions, .operation-apply-actions { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

.operation-history-actions { margin-bottom: 8px; }

.operation-history-actions small { color: #64716c; font-size: 11px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.operation-apply-actions { margin-top: 6px; }

.operation-history-actions button, .operation-apply-actions button { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

.operation-history-actions button:disabled, .operation-apply-actions button:disabled { color: #8a948f; cursor: not-allowed; }

.operation-outcome { display: grid; gap: 3px; margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px dashed #d9dfdb; }

.review-apply-drawer { display: grid; gap: 0; min-height: 0; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #c8d0cb; border-radius: 6px; background: #f8faf8; }

.review-apply-drawer-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }

.review-apply-drawer-header span { color: #68736f; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; }

.review-apply-drawer-header h2 { margin: 1px 0 3px; color: #263331; font-size: 14px; }

.review-apply-drawer-header p { margin: 0; color: #5f6b67; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.review-apply-drawer-header button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #263331; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }

.review-apply-detail-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

.review-apply-drawer.open .review-apply-detail-grid { max-height: none; margin-top: 10px; overflow: visible; opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

.panel-subtitle { margin-top: 10px; color: #59645f; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* Rule-pack structured AST expression composer (TP-C2-COMPOSER-001). */ .rule-pack-expression-composer { gap: 8px; }

.rule-pack-variable-browser { padding: 4px 0; color: #59645f; }

.rule-pack-expression-rendering { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #d9dfdb; border-radius: 6px; background: #f8faf8; color: #304139; }

.rule-pack-expression-rendering > small { color: #59645f; }

.rule-pack-expression-rendering > pre { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 12px; }

.rule-pack-node { display: grid; gap: 4px; border-left: 2px solid #d9dfdb; }

.rule-pack-node-label { color: #59645f; }

.rule-pack-node-readonly { color: #8a5a2b; }

.rule-pack-node-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; }

.rule-pack-node-field > span { min-width: 72px; color: #59645f; }

.rule-pack-operand { display: grid; gap: 4px; }

.rule-pack-table-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.rule-pack-check-statuses { display: grid; gap: 2px; }

.rule-pack-check-subgroup { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding-left: 8px; border-left: 2px solid #eef1ef; }

An absent // artifact fails the suite loudly here with the exact build command // (WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT → `npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop`); // no fallback engine exists. import { loadWasmEngine } from "../services/wasmEngine/loadWasmEngine";

import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react"; import { existsSync } from "node:fs"; import path from "node:path"; import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url"; import { defineConfig, type Plugin, type UserConfig } from "vite";

const desktopRoot = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

// TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001 build-time guard: the wasm operation engine is the // sole browser-mode engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001), so a production bundle // without `public/wasm-engine/` assets is broken by construction — the // packaged tauri:// asset protocol 404s onto index.html and the runtime dies // with WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT on first use. Fail the BUILD loudly instead // of shipping that. const WASM_ENGINE_ASSET_FILENAMES = [ "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.js", "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm" ];

function missingWasmEngineAssets(dir: string): string[] { return WASM_ENGINE_ASSET_FILENAMES.filter((name) => !existsSync(path.join(dir, "wasm-engine", name))); }

function wasmEngineGuardError(stage: string, dir: string, missing: string[]): Error { return new Error( `WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT: ${stage}: missing ${missing.join(", ")} under ${dir}/wasm-engine/ — ` + "the wasm operation engine is required in browser mode (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) and no fallback engine " + "exists. Build it with `npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop`, then rebuild." ); }

function wasmEngineDistGuard(): Plugin { return { name: "wasm-engine-dist-guard", apply: "build", buildStart() { const publicDir = path.join(desktopRoot, "public"); const missing = missingWasmEngineAssets(publicDir); if (missing.length > 0) { throw wasmEngineGuardError("production build input check failed", publicDir, missing); } }, closeBundle() { const distDir = path.join(desktopRoot, "dist"); const missing = missingWasmEngineAssets(distDir); if (missing.length > 0) { throw wasmEngineGuardError("production dist output check failed", distDir, missing); } } }; }

export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react(), wasmEngineDistGuard()], clearScreen: false, server: { port: 5173, strictPort: false }, build: { rollupOptions: { output: { manualChunks(id) { if (!id.includes("node_modules")) return undefined; if (id.includes("/three/")) return "vendor-three"; if (id.includes("/react/") || id.includes("/react-dom/")) return "vendor-react"; if (id.includes("/lucide-react/")) return "vendor-icons"; if (id.includes("/@tauri-apps/")) return "vendor-tauri"; return "vendor"; } } } }, test: { environment: "jsdom", globals: true, include: ["src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}"], setupFiles: "./src/test/setup.ts", // The App.test.tsx suite renders the full <App /> per case; under the // five-surface evidence sweep's machine load the default 5s test/hook // timeout trips a random handful of these renders (non-deterministic // failures, not assertion errors). Generous timeouts de-flake the suite; // a render that genuinely exceeds 30s indicates a real defect, not load. testTimeout: 30000, hookTimeout: 30000 } } as UserConfig & { test: Record<string, unknown> });
